title: pachycornia tenuis
intro: Pachycornia tenuis, commonly known as the Indian spurge, is a plant species belonging to the Euphorbiaceae family. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in providing relief from inflammation and pain. Its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties, which make it useful in treating wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Pachycornia tenuis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing.
